title: struthanthus microphyllus

The health benefits of Struthanthus microphyllus include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels due to its high levels of flavonoids and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Struthanthus microphyllus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
